text: Program Description: The public Administrations is a subject system, which applies the theories and methods of management, politics and economics to study the management activities and rules of public organizations. By learning it, students will know how to be a good public manager, how to coordinate conflicts of interests between departments, and how to formulate effective public policies. Teaching Goals: Through the study of public management, students can have the following abilities: 1. Have broad knowledge and culture in public administration, politics, management, law, economics, etc. 2. To have a deep understanding of the rules, mechanisms and methods governing public affairs and international affairs, and grasp the laws governing public affairs and international affairs. 3. Understand the influence of the contemporary information society and the global economic integration on the public management, especially the national affairs management, and pay more attention to the management concept and the management tools. 4. Master computer application and network application skillfully. 5. Have a high level of English and meet the needs of foreign affairs management. Future career: 1. International development banks, such as the Asian bank, the world bank, etc., are working in developing countries to foster economic, energy, environmental and other projects, and cooperate with governments. 2. The Ministry of policy and strategy in the high and new technology enterprises and transnational corporations generally has a strategic department, which is responsible for the study of the market and the national policies, and makes suggestions and strategies for the future planning of the enterprises. 3. Consulting company. In particular, it is a company that provides industrial and economic consultation. For example, McKinsey and so on Duration: 5 years
